caption: The drawing depicts a wooden secretary desk, shown in a three-quarter view. The desk is composed of light to medium brown wood tones, featuring various shades and natural wood grain patterns. The upper section consists of a pair of paneled cabinet doors with metal handles, positioned above a row of three small drawers, each with a round pull. Below these are four square compartments divided by thin partitions, with two central drawers, also with round pulls, flanked by two open cubbies on either side. The middle section of the desk includes a fold-down writing surface with a dark inlay or blotter, which is shown in the open position and supported by side extensions. The lower section of the desk has three wide drawers with round handles. The desk stands on four tapered legs. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the drawing includes subtle shading to indicate depth and dimension. A small handwritten note appears in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Shaker Secretary Desk
